caption: The drawing depicts a standing object resembling a Victorian fire screen. The screen is octagonal with a decorative border featuring an intricate repeating pattern of gold and tan vertical elements. Inside the border, the central section shows a colored scene of a young girl with auburn hair wearing a white dress with blue and red details, standing amidst green vegetation with tall grass and flowers, and a blue sky in the background. The fireplace screen is attached to a vertical pole, which is dark brown or mahogany and extends upward from a three-legged wooden base. The base is elaborate, with curving supports and decorative round finials, finished in the same dark wood color. In the upper left corner of the page is a small, line-drawn schematic showing the screen and stand in a simplified and reduced form, providing additional technical detail. The overall composition is centered on the page, bordered by a single, thin red line around the edges. The background of the drawing is a light beige or off-white color.
title: Embroidered Fire Screen
